pairs.difference: A (grad cap): the board, crown and gold band are smooth, soft matte clay with no surface marks. The button and tassel are simple broad shapes, like the real glove and computer cards. B (top hat): at 2× the black crown is covered in fine streaky brushed-felt noise in vertical and diagonal smears. The red band has a separate satin sheen with crinkle streaks. This is the photographic fabric texture the generated lesson cards add, such as the glove's dashed seam stitching and the monitor's scratches. Real cards keep surfaces clean.
pairs.fix: Draw the top hat crown as a smooth, soft, even matte black surface with no fabric streaks or brushed texture. Make the hatband a plain smooth red ribbon with one soft broad highlight, without satin crinkles.

pairs.difference: A (fan): soft, slightly blurry airbrush rendering. The hub is a smooth metal dome with one broad highlight, the blades are flat matte plastic, and the curtain folds are soft. No added grain. B (sandcastle): crisp, with small brick outlines scattered over the tower walls as decoration and sand-grain speckles and pebbles on the ground. This matches the generated lighthouses and PC cases, which add masonry and panel detail where real cards stay simple.
pairs.fix: Model the sandcastle walls as smooth packed sand with no brick lines or carved block marks. Make the ground soft, smooth sand without speckles or pebbles.

pairs.difference: A (buoy): the red body is uniform smooth plastic with soft broad highlights, and the bell is plain gold with one highlight. It is very simple and soft, almost under-detailed, but in line with the real lighthouse's clean red parts. B (suitcase): the brown shell has scattered scuffs, chipped patches and darker wear stains. The corner caps are separate leather pieces, and the floorboards show grain and plank lines. Added wear and grain is the generated tell from the lessons, such as the scratched monitor and the stitched glove.
pairs.fix: Make the suitcase a clean, smooth leather-brown shell with no scuffs, chips or stains. Keep the corner caps as simple rounded shapes and draw the floor as smooth planks without wood grain.

pattern: Generated cards add fine surface detail that real cards leave out: wear marks like scuffs, scratches and chips; dashed stitching and seams; scattered brick or block outlines; sand and grain speckles; and streaky fabric texture in the photo style. Real cards keep every material as smooth, soft, broad shapes with one clean highlight and no added micro-texture.
